## Estate registry — load-bearing

Portfolio technology, partner and gate decisions live in the Empire Registry (`frankxai/agentic-ops`, `registry/`). Agents with access read `registry/projections/AGENT_BRIEF.md` there before choosing a technology, model route, runtime or storage, or before any partner claim. This block is generated; change the registry, not this block.

- **Rings.** `adopt` is the default for new work; `trial` only within its recorded scope; `assess` for spikes, never production; `hold` and `retire` never for new work. A lapsed review counts as hold. A technology with no registry record needs a registry pull request before use.
- **Precedence.** Registry decisions win on technology and partner facts; this repository's own instructions win on local build, test and release gates. Report any disagreement instead of resolving it silently.
- **Freshness.** API shapes, versions, model IDs and prices come from documentation fetched in the same session, never from memory.

Decided stack: agent runtime — Cloudflare Agents; ai application sdk — Vercel AI SDK; binary storage — Vercel Blob; coding agent — Claude Code; durable execution — Cloudflare Workflows; durable execution — Vercel Workflows; evidence storage — Google Drive; hosting — Vercel hosting; human projection — Notion; media delivery — Vercel Image Optimization; model gateway — Vercel AI Gateway; relational data — Supabase Postgres; secrets — Infisical; stateful primitive — Cloudflare Durable Objects (SQLite); tool protocol — Model Context Protocol; web framework — Next.js App Router.

Do not expand: Cloudflare R2 (use Vercel Blob); Cloudinary (use Vercel Image Optimization); OpenRouter (use Vercel AI Gateway).

## Cursor Cloud specific instructions

- The root workspace is a pnpm/Turbo monorepo; package scripts in `package.json` are the source of truth for standard lint, test, build, and dev commands.
- Do not start the two primary web services with plain `pnpm dev` when testing both together: `@arcanea/web` runs on port `3001`, and `arcanea-premium-web` also defaults to `3001`. Run the web app with `pnpm dev:web`, and run the premium service with an explicit alternate port such as `PORT=3002 pnpm --filter arcanea-premium-web dev`.
- Full Supabase/auth/AI flows require the real environment variables documented in `apps/web/.env.example`. Public pages and the Academy gate quiz can run locally without those secrets, but AI generation and authenticated database flows are not end-to-end without Supabase plus Gemini credentials.
- Local Supabase startup with current CLI versions rejects the committed `supabase/config.toml` value `realtime.ip_version = "ipv4"`; use real remote Supabase env values, or fix/test that config casing before relying on `supabase start`.
- The root `pnpm test:quick` command expects built package artifacts for several workspace packages. If it reports missing `dist` files, build `@arcanea/core`, `@arcanea/extension-core`, `@arcanea/mcp-server`, and `@arcanea/auth` before rerunning it.
- MCP memory tests use the agent home directory and expect `~/.arcanea` to exist; create that directory in the current VM session before running those tests if it is absent.
